title: Institutional Food Service Management
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Institutional Food Service Management Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able to apply food safety and sanitation standards to institutional food service operations in compliance with regulatory requirements.

At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able to design and execute large-scale food production and service using standardized recipes, batch cooking methods, culinary math, and efficient workflow.

At the conclusion of this program, the student should be able to demonstrate the use of effective communication, teamwork, leadership, training, point-of-sale operations, and professional behavior within institutional kitchen environments.

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space (e.g., CULNB10); these were matched to the closed-list codes with a space (CULN B10, etc.) as the same courses, so none is marked a catalog addition.

Stated total is 18-31 units, while the award is described as requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S units; the upper end (31) exceeds that range because CULNB48WE is printed as 1-14 units. Reviewer may want to check.
Closed list stores CULN B48WE as 1 unit; catalog prints 1 - 14.

The Mandatory Fees paragraph says a California Food Manager certificate is required for 'degree completion' although this section is a Certificate of Achievement; recorded as printed, not as a course requirement.
